description: Lawmakers for too long have allowed corporate greed and environmental destruction to dominate public policy, all at the expense of the next generation’s future. Tennessee is rich in biodiversity, ranging from the Duck River, America’s most biodiverse river, to the old growth forests of the Smoky Mountains. From Antioch to the Appalachia, our fight for a greener future means building a multiracial, multiclass movement for environmental justice.

title: Environmental Justice - Justin Jones
